From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Monday, July 20, 2020 11:17 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Reassignment 
 
Ok, cool. Thank you.

Anthony
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Monday, July 20, 2020 10:48 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: Reassignment 
 
Anthony: Just following up on our conversation earlier.

Starting Tuesday, you’re reassigned to the web desk. The duties include, but are not limited to, writing breaking news, editing, building galleries, publishing video, or anything else we need help with.
I’ve got you scheduled noon-8 p.m. from Tuesday-Friday. I’ll evaluate next week’s schedule later this week.

Kirk will follow up with more details tomorrow. If there’s a reason the schedule doesn’t work this week, please let Kirk know and he can adjust it to what works best for him. Otherwise, be on Teams and ready to roll at noon.
Great Lakes regional sports director, USA TODAY Network
